Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Serene Tassled Wool Runner Rug, 2' 6" x 8', Multi
Materials: wool
80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported Delicate details of beige and blue accent this neutral runner. Its soft, soothing wool lends comfort and an elegant anchor to any traditional, transitional or contemporary room. 2'6" x 8' Hand-tufted in India Medium pile height makes it durable and easy to vacuum Vacuum, professionally clean Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
